findings: The package has no Fungi twin and exports structural contracts plus seven validators/report helpers. It performs no vector arithmetic, allocation, hardware selection or lowering.

Dimensions require Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value > 0; zero, negative zero, fractions, non-finite values and unsafe integers are rejected. Aggregate matrix/tensor element counts and memory requirements are not bounded.
Vector element types must be nonblank strings but are not restricted to NumericElementType; matrix and tensor types do not validate element types at all. QuantizedType has no runtime validator.

Vector operations validate name, inputs and output, then append at most one mismatch diagnostic using exact element-type/lane equality; empty input lists are accepted. Tensor operations validate names and individual shapes but do not check input/output compatibility, element types or pure.

Sparse tensor dimension arrays can skip holes under flatMap, and missing objects or non-string names can throw native exceptions. Preserve traversal, diagnostic ordering/paths, strict comparisons and omitted optional properties.

Reports retain supplied operation arrays and objects by reference; diagnostics are computed once and can become stale after mutation. tensorOperations is always returned despite its optional field, current errors produce no warnings, and defineVectorType throws a generic Error joining messages.

The Float32 example is data only. Five tests cover selected construction, dimensions, one vector mismatch and report/example success; they do not establish numerical correctness, SIMD/low-bit semantics, resource bounds or translation equivalence.
materialObligations: Preserve structural validation, native throw behavior, diagnostic ordering, arbitrary element-type acceptance, tensor asymmetry and zero-input operations or explicitly narrow the contract.
Bind tensor rank/size, aggregate memory requirements, layout/stride, numeric domains, backend support and sparse-array behavior before authority claims.
Preserve report reference/mutability, warning/error separation, optional-field output and generic Error construction semantics.
Keep TypeScript as the sole implementation shadow; no Fungi twin or consumer authority exists.
